q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is August 18, 2026. NVIDIA is scheduled to report Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026 (8 days from now). The forward guidance will be released at that time.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided official guidance for Q2 FY2027 during their May 20, 2026 earnings call:
- **Guided revenue: $91.0 billion ± 2%** (range: $89.18B to $92.82B)

This guidance came from management on May 20, 2026, and was confirmed in SEC filings. With only 8 days until the earnings release, there is virtually no time for material changes to guidance unless something dramatic occurs.

The most likely scenario is that NVIDIA will maintain this guidance or make only minor adjustments. Management has strong incentives to maintain guidance they've publicly stated, as material revisions would signal forecasting errors or changed business conditions—both negative signals to the market.

**Most likely guidance range: $89.0B to $92.8B, centered around $91.0B**

## (c) What would push the value lower?

1. **Demand deterioration discovered in final weeks**: If data center orders suddenly weakened or cancellations accelerated in late July/early August
2. **Customer delays or deferrals**: If major hyperscaler customers postponed orders
3. **Supply chain disruptions**: Though less likely at this stage
4. **Macro deterioration**: A significant economic downturn between May and August 2026 (unlikely given recent momentum)
5. **Regulatory/geopolitical headwinds**: Further export restrictions impacting China revenue exclusions or other markets

The research notes that China Data Center compute revenue is already excluded from guidance, so regulatory risk is partially priced in.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

1. **Better-than-expected demand**: Orders exceeding expectations in late July/August as AI infrastructure spending accelerates
2. **ASP expansion**: Higher average selling prices due to premium GPU mix or strong demand
3. **Upside surprise in non-Data Center segments**: Gaming, professional visualization, or automotive performing better than anticipated
4. **Customer acceleration**: Major customers front-loading orders ahead of new product cycles
5. **Competitive displacement**: Market share gains from competitors' product delays or issues

Given the 85% YoY growth in Q1 FY2027 and continued momentum in Data Center (92% YoY), upside bias is possible.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- **Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion** (their previous quarter)
- **Q1 FY2027 guidance accuracy**: The company guided to a certain range and delivered within it
- **Analyst consensus for Q2 FY2027: $91.846 billion** (more conservative estimate) to **$93.5 billion** (higher estimate)
- **Management's explicit Q2 guidance (May 20, 2026): $91.0 billion ± 2%**

NVIDIA's recent track record shows strong execution—Q1 delivered record results. The company guided conservatively for Q2 at $91.0B, which is only ~11.6% above Q1 actuals. Given the strong momentum and analyst consensus trending toward $91.8B-$93.5B, this suggests potential for guidance to be at the higher end of their range or even modestly above.

## Probability Distribution Reasoning

The range provided is $99.5B to $115.5B (with open bounds), suggesting the question is asking about the forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 or beyond (not Q2 actual results). However, the question title says "Q2 FY2027 guidance" which typically means guidance *given at* the Q2 earnings call, which would be for Q3.

**Re-interpreting**: If this asks for Q3 FY2027 forward guidance (to be announced at Q2 earnings):

Given:
- Q1 FY2027: $81.6B actual
- Q2 FY2027: $91.0B guided (May 20)
- Q3 FY2027 guidance: Not yet known, to be announced Aug 26

Historical progression suggests ~10-12% sequential growth. Q3 could reasonably be guided at $100-105B, which would be:
- ~11% sequential growth from Q2
- Consistent with seasonal patterns in AI/data center
- Aligned with analyst expectations for continued momentum

The $99.5B-$115.5B range suggests high expectation for strong forward guidance.

**Central estimate: $102-105B** (approximately 12% growth from Q2 guided revenue)

This would indicate confidence in sustained momentum without being excessive.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to report its Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026, after market close, covering the period that ended in late July 2026 [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors), [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, released on May 20, 2026, projects revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/), [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). Consensus analyst estimates for Q2 FY2027 revenue are around $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors), with some aggregators pegging it closer to $93.5 billion [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

The company's Q1 FY2027 revenue was a record $81.6 billion, up 85% year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). Data Center revenue in Q1 FY2027 was $75.2 billion, up 92% year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).
